seeds.sg-5-1-0-0: In the humming blue gallery, Pell pries open a maintenance hatch while shifting lens-segments groan overhead.
seeds.sg-5-1-0-1: Beneath the fractured dome, you dodge a swinging focusing plate while groping for a hidden maintenance ladder.
seeds.sg-5-1-1-0: Pell leads you through a cool conduit where singing glass reverberates against your ribs with warning tones.
seeds.sg-5-1-1-1: In a tilted mirror-vault, your guide spots a greasy grease-slick left by previous rivals scrambling upward.
seeds.sg-5-1-1-2: You squeeze past a jammed prism-shutter whose sharp edges threaten to sever your precious ember-lamp strap.
seeds.sg-5-1-1-3: A collapsed ceiling of bottle-green cullet forces you to crawl beneath jagged pendants that swing like pendulums.
seeds.sg-5-1-1-4: Unencumbered by debts or escorts, you spot a forgotten maintenance duct that bypasses the noisy main gear-room.
seeds.sg-5-1-1-5: You stumble into an abandoned observatory ward where rusted brass rings obscure the upward escape route completely.
seeds.sg-5-1-2-0: Pell taps a hollow ceramic flue, unlocking a narrow service chute that bypasses three patrols of nervous sentries.
seeds.sg-5-1-2-1: You climb a spiral ramp of fused sand while distant signal-flashes bounce blindingly off polished brass walls.
seeds.sg-5-1-2-2: A rusted bulkhead blocks the ventilation conduit, demanding all your strength to force its warped hinges open.
seeds.sg-5-1-3-0: You slip past a dormant automaton whose glass eyes catch the faint, sputtering glow of your coal-lantern.
seeds.sg-5-1-3-1: In a dim cistern-room, dripping condensation threatens to drown your sole remaining source of heat and light.
seeds.sg-5-1-3-2: You wedge your shoulder against a shifting glass pane to clear a path through a blocked maintenance tunnel.
seeds.sg-5-1-3-3: Traveling entirely alone, you notice a subtle draft whispering through a hairline fracture in the masonry wall.
seeds.sg-5-1-3-4: A cascade of loose glass beads rattles down the sloping floor, threatening to betray your silent ascent.
seeds.sg-5-1-3-5: You navigate a labyrinth of convex mirrors that distort your reflection into a dozen terrifying, phantom pursuers.
seeds.sg-5-1-3-6: Thick salt crust crunches beneath your boots in a forgotten archive, leaving a damning trail for any trackers.
seeds.sg-5-1-3-7: You crawl through an air-vent lined with velvet soot that blackens your face and chokes your breathing.
seeds.sg-5-1-3-8: A dangling brass counterweight swings across your narrow ledge, timing your frantic leap with lethal precision.
seeds.sg-5-1-3-9: You cross a fragile glass bridge suspended over a yawning shaft where ancient machinery groans in darkness.
seeds.sg-5-1-3-10: Pungent ozone fills a chamber where broken copper wires spit faint blue sparks into the dry air.
seeds.sg-5-1-3-11: You flatten yourself against a fluted pillar as a patrol of mirror-bearers marches past with rhythmic clinking.
seeds.sg-5-1-3-12: A stubborn latch on a ventilation grille requires you to risk a noisy strike with your heavy tool.
seeds.sg-5-1-3-13: You scramble up a vertical cable-run while greasy soot makes every handhold a slippery, terrifying gamble.
seeds.sg-5-1-3-14: The Seedkey vibrates warmly against your chest, reacting to a hidden network of resonant quartz veins nearby.
seeds.sg-5-1-3-15: You squeeze through an aperture so narrow you must extinguish your ember-lamp and crawl blind in pitch black.
seeds.sg-5-1-4-0: High above the Basin floor, a whistling gale through the broken roof tests your footing on slick glass.
seeds.sg-5-1-4-1: You climb a leaning framework of iron girders toward the blinding white glare of the upper terraces.
seeds.sg-5-1-4-2: A sentinel's mirror-flash sweeps across your hiding alcove, forcing you to freeze amid dangling copper wires.
seeds.sg-5-1-4-3: You claw your way up a choked drainage flue that smells faintly of ancient oil and dried desert lime.
seeds.sg-5-1-4-4: The air grows thin and scorching as you approach the grand solar-collector terrace where sentries keep watch.
seeds.sg-5-1-4-5: You slip behind a stack of spare lenses while a glass-diver argues heatedly with a nervous sentry outside.
seeds.sg-5-1-4-6: A crumbling stone balustrade gives way beneath your hand, sending a clatter of debris echoing down the shaft.
seeds.sg-5-1-4-7: You emerge onto the threshold of the Sentry Terrace, where sharp mirror-signals slice through the blinding light.
seeds.sg-5-1-5-0: You crouch behind a low sun-shield while Glasswright sentries semaphore swift warnings across the dizzying drop.
seeds.sg-5-1-5-1: A veteran sentry turns his polished brass plate toward you, demanding your credentials in abrupt flashes of light.
seeds.sg-5-1-5-2: You edge along the outer parapet of the terrace, praying the whistling wind masks your frantic footsteps.
seeds.sg-5-1-5-3: You raise your hand to mirror the sentry's complex code, gambling your entire journey on a single imitated flash.
seeds.sg-d-5-1: You sprint blindly across the open mirror-terrace, drawing a coordinated volley of blinding light-beams that ignite your pack.
seeds.sg-5-1-2-3: Pell coaxes open a stubborn floor-grate, revealing a steep drop into the cooling flues of the great lens.
seeds.sg-5-1-2-4: You scramble over a ridge of fused green slag while distant foghorns moan across the empty salt basin.
seeds.sg-5-1-2-5: In a narrow utility shaft, your shoulder bumps a hanging brass chime that reverberates like an alarm bell.
seeds.sg-5-1-2-6: Pell points out a faint scratch on the glass floor, marking the safe seam in a minefield of trapdoors.
seeds.sg-5-1-2-7: You pry open a jammed louver, letting a rush of hot desert air and blinding glare into the dim shaft.
seeds.sg-5-1-2-8: A nest of rusted iron gears blocks your passage, forcing you to crawl through their grease-stained center.
seeds.sg-5-1-2-9: Pell tosses a pebble into a dizzying vertical drop to test the acoustic echo of the lower vaults.
seeds.sg-5-1-2-10: You squeeze through a buckled copper frame where the walls of the observatory are slowly crushing inward.
seeds.sg-5-1-2-11: A flurry of wind-blown salt dust blinds you momentarily as you navigate a ledge above a sheer drop.
seeds.sg-5-1-2-12: Pell wedges a crowbar into a refractory brick wall, prizing open a forgotten passage used by telescope-cleaners.
seeds.sg-5-1-2-13: You scramble across a floor of loose glass shards that slide dangerously beneath the weight of your pack.
seeds.sg-5-1-2-14: The cracked Seedkey hums violently against your coat, pointing directly through a solid wall of tinted crystal.
seeds.sg-5-1-2-15: You duck beneath a swinging iron counterweight that sweeps back and forth across the low service tunnel.
